items.q: How much does Odoo cost in total?
items.a: Two parts: Odoo licenses, billed by Odoo per user, and our fixed implementation fee. You get both numbers after the Blueprint, before you commit to the build.
Typically {buildServices} for service companies and {buildProducts} with inventory or manufacturing. The Blueprint gives you a dated plan.

items.q: Will we lose our QuickBooks history?
items.a: We migrate what your accountant needs — customers, vendors, items, opening balances and history — and agree the cutover date with them.

items.q: Does it handle US sales tax?
items.a: Yes. Odoo calculates sales tax, and we can connect Avalara for multi-state rules. We have set this up for US companies before.

items.q: Can our accountant keep working the way they do?
items.a: Yes. They own the chart of accounts and sign off on the setup. We can train their team too.

items.q: How do you set up inventory valuation and COGS?
items.a: Together with your accountant: costing method, landed costs and valuation accounts are agreed in the Blueprint.

items.q: Can you connect our storefront and marketplaces?
items.a: In most cases, yes. We confirm the connectors and any custom work during the Blueprint.

items.q: What barcode scanners do we need?
items.a: Standard USB or Bluetooth scanners and mobile devices work. We recommend hardware in the Blueprint.

items.q: What if the project goes over budget?
items.a: Each phase has a fixed price. If we underestimate, that’s on us. Scope changes are quoted before any work starts.

items.q: You’re in Europe — how do meetings work?
items.a: Calls and demos happen during US business hours, and you get a written update every week.

items.q: Who owns the code and the data?
items.a: You do. Full documentation, no lock-in.
{hypercare} of hypercare, then optional managed Odoo (Keep) for support, updates and improvements.
